headline: Strategic Base Exchanges Ease Across Six Fronts
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the pace of strategic‑base turnover has softened on the most contested sectors. Weathered Expanse now records thirty‑four flips in the past 24 hours, down from forty‑one, while casualties climb to roughly 13,600 Colonial and 17,700 Warden and enlistments accelerate to 82 per hour. Fishermans Row remains the busiest theatre with forty‑two flips centred on Black Well, Eidolo, Arcadia, Fort Ember and Hangman’s Court, a modest decline from the previous fifty‑two. Stlican Shelf logs thirty‑five flips across Thornhold, The Pale House, Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn, slightly fewer than the earlier thirty‑seven. Mooring County has fallen to eighteen daily flips from twenty‑two, and Farranac Coast slips to eleven from twelve. Linn Mercy shows a modest rise to twenty flips, driven by renewed fighting at Lathair. Stonecradle holds steady at twelve flips. Enlistment rates are accelerating in all active zones, indicating fresh manpower feeding the exchanges, while quieter fronts such as Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields and the northern Warden‑held regions report no new flips and only marginal casualty changes.
